context: Hybrid local-first React SaaS app; scripted interview demo with no backend, external AI calls, payments, or image assets

key_tasks: choose Mock, Practice, or Assessment mode
upload curriculum, candidates, or technical spec JSON
configure model/prompt settings without making API calls
success_actions: finish at least 8 questions across 4+ curriculum days
return to dashboard and resume locally
phase_1_discovery.emotion: calm competence under pressure: the visual story moves from orientation, to focused challenge, to evidence-backed reflection
phase_1_discovery.theme: Support light and dark themes. Default dark for interview focus, with a persistent toggle and accessible contrast in both modes.
phase_1_discovery.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast with a restrained performance-pro edge; use color as function, not decoration

descriptors: clear value proposition and single primary CTA
product proof visible above the fold
sparse editorial composition rather than feature dumping
controls placed close to the data

phase_2_research.synthesis: Fuse an oral-exam room, a Swiss editorial grid, and a calm command center: a narrow reading rail for the live question, a visible evidence timeline, and a report that feels like an annotated examiner's notebook.

design_options.name: Exam Room
design_options.direction: dark graphite, paper-white type, signal vermilion for live state; cinematic focus and minimal chrome

design_options.name: Field Notes
design_options.direction: warm bone light mode, ink navy, ochre annotations, editorial serif headings

design_options.name: Signal Console
design_options.direction: cool charcoal, electric blue status accents, technical grid borders and monospace metadata

design_options.name: Quiet Athletic
design_options.direction: obsidian, white, blaze red progress cues, condensed impact headings

design_options.name: Cohort Atlas
design_options.direction: light stone, deep forest ink, muted saffron topic markers, map-like curriculum day progression

chosen_direction: Exam Room + Field Notes: dark-first interview focus with an editorial light report mode. This breaks the generic AI gradient pattern to make the candidate feel guided, not sold to.

typography.heading: Bodoni Moda or Cormorant Garamond, font-light/medium, tracking-tight; use only for landing, report, and section headings
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans, 400/500/600; use for UI, questions, labels, and readable long text
typography.metadata: IBM Plex Mono, 400/500; use for question IDs, curriculum day, timers, scores, and JSON status
rules: never use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings
signal red only communicates live/attention/error states
verify normal text at 4.5:1 and large text at 3:1
do not use forbidden #7351B7 or dashboard teal #1B93A4

visual_enhancers: subtle CSS grain using an aria-hidden pseudo-element at 3-5% opacity
hairline grid lines on admin and dashboard regions
soft layered shadows only on raised surfaces
solid opaque or blurred glass header; never fully transparent
thin red examiner mark beside active question
custom scrollbar with tinted thumb and no gutter
selection color using signal red with readable text

navigation.desktop: opaque/sticky header with ABTalks AI mark, Dashboard, Interview, Feedback, Admin links, theme toggle, and Start interview CTA
navigation.mobile: brand, theme toggle, and menu button; reveal links in an opaque Sheet, never hide desktop links
navigation.header_classes: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-background/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border

grids.landing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12; hero spans 8 columns, proof panel spans 4, leave one open cell
grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6; summary col-span-1, readiness chart col-span-2 row-span-2, recent activity col-span-1 row-span-2
grids.interview: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-10; question rail lg:col-span-7, progress/evidence rail lg:col-span-5
grids.feedback: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 gap-8; report hero md:col-span-5, score summary md:col-span-3, topic table full width
grids.admin: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6; upload/settings col-span-1, JSON preview col-span-2, activity col-span-1
rules: grid items must be direct children
use p-6 or p-8 inside bordered containers
do not fill every cell; preserve intentional breathing room

landing: left-aligned hero with overline 'ABTALKS AI COHORT'
headline 'Practice the questions that production asks'
short paragraph and Start interview primary CTA
right-side stacked interview preview with 8-question counter and curriculum day markers
three mode selector: Mock, Practice, Assessment
how it works in three numbered steps
final dark contrast-shift footer with large ABTalks AI wordmark
candidate_selection: profile picker using Shadcn Select or searchable Command, not native select
candidate identity row with avatar initials, completed days, strengths, weak areas
mode cards with explicit selected state
continue CTA disabled until profile and mode exist
dashboard: readiness score, interviews completed, strongest topic, focus topic
curriculum day rail with completed/current/locked states
recent interview list and recommendation panel
interview: top status bar: mode, question 03/08, elapsed timer, exit control
large question text left aligned; follow-up transcript below
answer textarea using Shadcn Textarea with character hint and keyboard submit affordance
right rail has progress, curriculum topics, confidence pulse, local scoring rationale after submission
show one question at a time; after submit reveal follow-up with a short entrance animation
feedback: report header with candidate, mode, date and export actions
topic score rows for RAG, Prompt Engineering, Vector Databases, MCP, Agentic AI, Deployment, Production Systems
question-by-question examiner notes and restart CTA
admin: JSON upload dropzone built with Shadcn input/label and local FileReader
tabs for Candidates, Curriculum, Technical Spec, Model/Prompt Settings
opaque JSON preview with validation status
settings clearly state LOCAL SCRIPTED MODE; no API key field by default
reset local data action with AlertDialog

use: Button, Badge, Card selectively, Tabs, Progress, Textarea, Input, Select, Command, Sheet, AlertDialog, Switch, Tooltip, Sonner
rules: raw HTML/Tailwind is appropriate for marketing layout; use Shadcn logic for advanced interactions
all buttons, links, inputs, menus, timers, scores, question text, errors and confirmation text need data-testid

recommended IDs include landing-start-interview-button, candidate-profile-select, interview-submit-answer-button, interview-question-text, interview-progress-indicator, feedback-export-button, admin-json-upload-input, theme-toggle-button

motion.entrance: stagger direct grid children by 60ms with opacity and translate-y
motion.interaction: specific transitions for transform, opacity, background-color, border-color; never transition-all
motion.interview: question changes slide 8px horizontally; score reveal uses number count only when motion is allowed
motion.hover: buttons lift 1px, bordered rows shift border signal color, cards lift -translate-y-1
motion.loading: use skeleton bars and a pulsing live indicator, never a fake API spinner
motion.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) set animation-duration: .01ms, disable parallax and transform entrances

accessibility: timer has text label and does not rely on color
announce submitted answer and next question with aria-live
do not place text over unreadable imagery; this app needs no imagery
provide accessible status text for selected mode, completed days, score and upload validation
support light/dark theme contrast and avoid pure transparent surfaces

media.guidance: No stock imagery is needed; use UI close-ups, grid, grain, and typographic hierarchy to keep the product focused and fast. Do not introduce placeholder image URLs.

3d_libraries.reason: This is a clarity-first dashboard/interview workflow; 3D would distract from timed reading and answer entry.

data_and_local_behavior.persistence: localStorage keys: abtalks-candidate, abtalks-mode, abtalks-progress, abtalks-responses, abtalks-feedback, abtalks-theme
data_and_local_behavior.interview_engine: script at least 8 primary questions across at least 4 curriculum days, with deterministic follow-ups selected from answer keywords/confidence/mistakes; no API calls
data_and_local_behavior.scoring: local rubric scoring for correctness, specificity, tradeoffs, production awareness and confidence; show rubric language in feedback
data_and_local_behavior.uploads: validate JSON shape in browser, show errors via Sonner and inline status, preserve last valid dataset
data_and_local_behavior.export: generate a printable report or client-side JSON download; label PDF-style print as local export

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the local-first flow end to end; do not add backend calls, payment, or AI provider SDKs.
Make the first screen a professional landing page with a clear Start interview CTA.
Use candidates.json as the profile source and provide a graceful local fallback only if upload/data is missing.
Keep mode, theme, and interview progress resumable through localStorage.
Use explicit empty, error, selected, disabled, submitting, completed, and exported states.
Avoid generic centered layouts, purple AI gradients, emoji icons, excessive rounded cards, and oversized headings.
Ensure every interactive and key informational element has a stable kebab-case data-testid.
Test mobile at 390px and desktop at 1440px; interview answer area must remain usable with keyboard and touch.
Make all surfaces opaque or appropriately blurred; never use complete transparent backgrounds behind content.
Use Sonner for upload/export/reset feedback and Shadcn components for dialogs, select, tabs, textarea, and inputs.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Content should be left aligned by default and paced with generous spacing.
Color is functional: primary for actions, signal for live attention, green for verified progress, amber for caution.
Every interactive element has hover, active, focus, disabled, and reduced-motion behavior.
Use nested radii where helpful, maximum 8px for dashboard surfaces; pills only for statuses and primary CTAs.
Prefer borders and tonal surfaces over shadows; use shadows only to establish layer hierarchy.
Never use assistant emoji characters as icons; use lucide-react or existing UI icons.
Customize scrollbars and preserve browser zoom/reflow.
Keep copy specific, humane, and examiner-like; avoid claims of real AI when the experience is scripted.
Clearly disclose LOCAL SCRIPTED MODE anywhere model/prompt settings appear.
